HOrbitalDiagonal.finiteKernel_indented_orbital_trace.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)] [BorelSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)]
  (lambda : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)) (b : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℝ)
  (hb : ∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), 0 < b x)
  (E : Submodule ℂ ↥(Lp ℂ 2 (NArithmeticUnfolding.quotientMeasure K lambda))) [FiniteDimensional ℂ ↥E]
  (A :
    ↥(Lp ℂ 2 (NArithmeticUnfolding.quotientMeasure K lambda)) →L[ℂ]
      ↥(Lp ℂ 2 (NArithmeticUnfolding.quotientMeasure K lambda))) :
  let mu := NArithmeticUnfolding.quotientMeasure K lambda;
  have k := DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b E A;
  have orbit := fun q x =>
    ↑(∑' (t : Kˣ),
          NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K ((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) t * x) *
            NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K
              ((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) t * ((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) q⁻¹ * x))) *
      k ↑((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) q⁻¹ * x) ↑x;
  Integrable (fun x => ∑' (q : Kˣ), orbit q x) (lambda.withDensity (NArithmeticUnfolding.indentationDensity K)) ∧
    Integrable (fun x => ∑' (q : Kˣ), ‖orbit q x‖) (lambda.withDensity (NArithmeticUnfolding.indentationDensity K)) ∧
      ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K),
          ∑' (q : Kˣ), orbit q x ∂lambda.withDensity (NArithmeticUnfolding.indentationDensity K) =
        Masullo.TraceClass.trace (E.starProjection.comp A)
